source.paraphrase: Universal load files run on the server and the client, so they must never import a .server module. Server-only reads stay in +page.server.ts; the universal load receives public data.

invariants.why: A .server import in a universal load drags server-only code into the client bundle, or fails the build once the boundary is enforced.
invariants.fixHint: Move the server-only read into +page.server.ts and return public data for the universal load to consume.
invariants.avoid: A lazy import() of the .server module is still a .server import. A re-export through an index file is still the same module.

source.paraphrase: redirect() takes a 3xx status and a location. A 200, 404 or 500 status is not a redirect, so failure paths throw error() with the real status instead.

invariants.why: A redirect with a non-3xx status lies about the outcome: clients and caches treat the response as the status says, not as the location says.
invariants.fixHint: Use a 3xx status (303 after a mutation, 307 to preserve the method) in redirect(). Use error(404, ...) or error(500, ...) for failure paths.
invariants.avoid: A 404 that should show a page still needs error(), not redirect(). A 500 that should land somewhere still needs error() plus logging.

relations.why: SK-FORM-001 tells form actions to throw error() for unexpected failures, and TS-THROW-001 denies that throw inside the exported actions object.
relations.settle: On SvelteKit 2 call error(...) without the throw keyword: it throws itself and no throw statement remains. On SvelteKit 1, exclude **/+page.server.ts and **/+server.ts from TS-THROW-001.

source.paraphrase: Actions signal expected form failures by returning fail() and unexpected failures by throwing error(). A thrown plain object reaches neither channel.

invariants.why: A thrown object bypasses both the use:enhance failure path and the error boundary, so the form never renders the validation message.
invariants.fixHint: Return fail(status, data) for expected validation failures. Throw error(status, message) for unexpected failures.
invariants.avoid: An object shaped like fail() output is still wrong when thrown. A thrown status field does not set the response status.

source.paraphrase: Page options are exact lowercase exports such as prerender. A differently cased export is an unused variable the router silently ignores.

invariants.why: A mis-cased option compiles and deploys, but the route is never prerendered, so the launch checklist passes while the behavior is missing.
invariants.fixHint: Spell the option exactly `prerender` in lowercase, with a boolean or 'auto' value.
invariants.avoid: preRender, PreRender and PRERENDER are all dead exports. Assigning 'auto' to a mis-cased name does not fix the casing.

source.paraphrase: Modules placed in a server directory such as $lib/server are server-only. SvelteKit refuses to import them into code that runs in the browser.

invariants.why: Universal loads and client hooks ship to the browser, so a $lib/server import either fails the build or drags database clients and secrets into the client bundle.
invariants.fixHint: Do the server-only read in +page.server.ts or +layout.server.ts and return public data; the universal load receives it as data.
invariants.avoid: A relative ../lib/server path or a lazy import() is the same module. Type-only imports are erased and are not matched; .server file names are covered by SK-PAGE-001.

source.paraphrase: Don't use redirect() inside a try block, as the redirect will immediately trigger the catch statement.

invariants.why: redirect() works by throwing, so a surrounding catch turns the redirect into a failure response or an error page and the user never moves.
invariants.fixHint: Keep only the fallible work inside try, store its result, and call redirect() after the try/catch block.
invariants.avoid: A catch that throws a new error still swallows the redirect. Redirects inside catch or finally-only blocks, and catch blocks that rethrow the caught value, are not matched.

source.paraphrase: +server files export functions named after HTTP verbs: GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS and HEAD. SvelteKit throws on any other export without a _ prefix.

invariants.why: The pre-1.0 lowercase names (get, post, del) are invalid exports, so the endpoint fails with Invalid export instead of answering the request.
invariants.fixHint: Rename the handler to the uppercase verb (get to GET, del to DELETE) and type it with RequestHandler.
invariants.avoid: A RequestHandler annotation or a named export list does not change the exported name. Local helpers named get, _-prefixed exports and page options are not matched.

source.paraphrase: The cookies helper is only provided to server load functions (+page.server.ts and +layout.server.ts). Universal load functions (+page.ts and +layout.ts) run in the browser as well and cannot read or set server cookies.

invariants.why: Calling cookies.set or cookies.delete in a universal load file (+page.ts or +layout.ts) fails at runtime because universal loads do not receive the server cookies API.
invariants.fixHint: Rename the load file to +page.server.ts or +layout.server.ts, or move the cookie write into a form action or +server.ts endpoint.
invariants.avoid: Matches cookies.set and cookies.delete inside +page.ts, +layout.ts, +page.js, and +layout.js. Server load files (+page.server.ts) and differently named client cookie helpers pass.
